title: Pandian Stores 2
description: The sight of Thangamayil's family at Muthuvel's house leaves Saravanan seething with anger. Arasi rejects Karthikeyan's confession and warns him to keep his distance.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Sembaruthi seeks Manickam's help to find a new rental home. Meanwhile, Nadesan's visit to her Idli stall takes him back to their old romantic memories, making him emotional.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sinthamani and her husband scheme to bring Rekha and Sathya back home permanently. Visiting the park with Kanaga, Manoj anxiously stays out of Parvathy's sight.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath leads a discussion on couples' photography expectations. Partners share their struggles with getting the perfect pictures clicked by their loved ones.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Fun-filled games, and the arrival of Teddy and King Kong fill the competitive round with excitement. The kids delight singer Chitra with a special birthday celebration.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The International Cuisine round concludes with outstanding dishes from the junior and senior teams. Anxiety grips the contestants as the elimination unfolds for both teams.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: The game heats up as your favourite serial actors join the show with vibrant energy and entertaining moments. Tune in to see if luck favours them in the exciting challenges.
